markets.question: Will Bitcoin close above $100k by end of April 2026?

markets.question: Will Ethereum reach $5,000 before May 2026?

markets.question: Will Solana (SOL) surpass $300 before June 2026?

markets.question: Will total crypto market cap exceed $5T before July 2026?
